description:
Hello 
 Greeting from BCforward 
 
 Position: Application Developer 
 Location: DENVER CO 80202 
 Duration: 3+months 
 Design and build custom integrations and automations to the Qualtrics customer experience SaaS platform, interfacing with 3rd party systems (e.g., CRM, ERP, HRIS, LMS, etc.) via standard API's, web services, and batch processing. No prior experience using the Qualtrics platform is necessary. 
 We're looking for a hands-on lead, or even a senior engineer that has experience overseeing / managing offshore resources 
 * Project level integration architecture / design skills 
 * Client Interaction Skills 
 From technology stack perspective - here is a list ranked by priority. The resource doesn't have to have all skills but should be able to oversee the work related in different areas with an offsite team. 
 Preferred: 
 Node/Express/Javascript (likely the stack they will be working in) 
 Angular on the MEAN stack 
 Linux/Bash 
 DevOps (Docker, Jenkins, Monitoring, Logging) 
 Nice-to-Have (ranked by order): 
 Ruby
 PHP
 Python
 Java


 Namratha Gandavarapu
Sr. Recruiter
Direct: 317-210-8733
